measures.what: outer diameter of the round board
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: board thickness, and the two mounting holes: diameter of each and the centre-to-centre distance between them
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk diameter: I can't measure that; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: position of each mounting hole centre measured from the disc centre (distance and direction), and the distance from the disc centre to where the input wires leave the edge
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12

measures.what: overall length, width and thickness of the board
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: the four corner hole diameters and their centre spacing along length and width
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge

measures.what: height of the USB-C port's mouth above the perfboard's top face, and the USB-C port's mouth width and height; and the distance from the port mouth to the nearest board edge
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.what: plug body width, thickness, and length from the plug's tip to the back of the shell (the part that sits beside the wall socket)
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

measures.item: wall screws you'll hang the box on

measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most; wall screws spacing: I can put them wherever you say

measures.what: distance from the ESP32's centreline to the perfboard's centreline across its 50 mm width (i.e., is it centred)
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm
